description: Dashboard with details of the container metrics, host OS metrics and the Kubernetes cluster.

links.title: Unraid Syslog
links.tooltip: Search and filter all Unraid logs

panels.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together
panels.title: CPU Busy

panels.description: Busy state of all CPU cores together (5 min average)
panels.title: Sys Load (5m avg)

panels.description: System uptime
panels.title: Uptime
Syslog errors (24h)
panels.description: Unraid syslog lines at error severity or worse in the last 24 hours. Click through to Unraid Syslog for details.

panels.title: CPU Usage per Container
panels.description: Share of total host CPU used by each container (100% = every thread busy), so it adds up against the CPU Busy card. Whatever the containers don't account for is the Home Assistant VM and the host itself.

panels.title: Used Memory per Container
panels.description: Working set per container: memory actually in use, excluding reclaimable page cache (for example Plex reading media files). This is what counts toward a container's memory limit. Each line is one container, so the axis matches the values in the legend and tooltip. For the host total, see the Memory card.

panels.title: Received Network Traffic per Container
panels.description: Megabytes per second received by each container. VPN tunnel interfaces (wg*, tun*) are excluded so VPN containers like qBittorrent are not counted twice.

panels.title: Sent Network Traffic per Container
panels.description: Megabytes per second sent by each container. VPN tunnel interfaces (wg*, tun*) are excluded so VPN containers like qBittorrent are not counted twice.

panels.title: Memory usage per container
panels.description: Used = working set (excludes reclaimable page cache). Peak = highest usage since the container started. Limit = the container's memory limit; 'No limit' means it can use any free memory.

panels.title: Memory vs limit (containers with a limit)
panels.description: Working set against the memory limit for containers that have one (Plex is capped at 4 GiB). Containers with no limit are not shown; they appear in the table as 'No limit'.

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Kubernetes nodes reporting Ready. Red if any node is down.

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Pods currently in the Running phase across all namespaces.

panels.title: Pods unhealthy
panels.description: Pods stuck Pending, Failed or Unknown. Should be 0.

panels.title: Restarts (range)
panels.description: Container restarts within the selected time range.

panels.title: OOM kills (range)
panels.description: Containers whose most recent restart in the selected range was caused by hitting their memory limit.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__range])) > 0) and on(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cluster CPU
panels.description: Average CPU busy across the Kubernetes nodes.

panels.title: Cluster memory
panels.description: Memory in use across the Kubernetes nodes (excluding reclaimable cache).

panels.title: Node CPU busy
panels.description: CPU busy per Kubernetes node.

panels.title: Node memory used
panels.description: Memory in use per Kubernetes node (excluding reclaimable cache).

panels.title: Top pods by CPU
panels.description: Ten busiest pods right now, in CPU cores.

panels.title: Top pods by memory
panels.description: Ten pods using the most memory (working set).

panels.title: Containers closest to memory limit
panels.description: Working set as a share of the memory limit. Near 100% means an OOM kill is likely.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",namespace!=""}) / on(namespace,pod,container) max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Fullest volumes
panels.description: Persistent volumes by percentage of capacity used.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts over time, per pod. Gaps are normal; any bar is a container that crashed or was killed.

panels.title: Restarts in range
panels.description: Containers that restarted in the selected time range and why they last terminated (OOMKilled means memory limit hit).

panels.title: Busiest disks (I/O busy %)
panels.description: Share of the selected time range each spinning disk spent doing I/O. Highest = most active. Disks are named by serial number, which stays the same across reboots (sdX letters do not).

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (serial) ((increase(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}[$__range]) and on(device,instance) (node_disk_ata_rotation_rate_rpm{job="unraid-nodeexporter"} > 0)) * on(device,instance) group_left(serial) node_disk_info{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}) / $__range_s

panels.title: Disk throughput (read + write)
panels.description: Combined read and write rate per spinning disk, named by serial number.

targets.expr: sum by (serial) (((rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="unraid-nodeexporter"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(device,instance) (node_disk_ata_rotation_rate_rpm{job="unraid-nodeexporter"} > 0)) * on(device,instance) group_left(serial) node_disk_info{job="unraid-nodeexporter"})

panels.title: Log volume by severity
panels.description: Unraid syslog lines per interval.

panels.title: Errors and kernel problems (OOM, hung tasks, I/O)

targets.expr: {job="unraid-syslog"} |~ "(?i)out of memory|oom-kill|oom_reaper|hung task|blocked for more than|call trace|i/o error|machine check|segfault|soft lockup|hard lockup|ata[0-9]+.*(error|failed|reset)"
